# KTH Learning-Based Downlink Power Allocation Datasets

**Aliases:** Datasets associated with Learning-Based Downlink Power Allocation in Cell-Free Massive MIMO Systems

A KTH cell-free massive-MIMO dataset containing large-scale fading inputs and labeled locally optimal downlink power coefficients for sum-spectral-efficiency and proportional-fairness objectives under MR and RZF precoding.
